# What a stack's pages may be written under, and what is refused there with a
# position.
#
# A stack's pages are fixed when it is built, so a `for` among them iterates a
# constant and an `if` among them reads none of the program's state. A page
# under a `for` is one page per element, a copy whose record holds the
# iteration beside the page's id, so a second loop inside the first is not
# supported yet, and the copy takes no params: it reads its element. A group --
# a component that renders pages without being one -- keeps no state of its
# own, since nothing holds it once its pages are spliced into the stack.
# android writes a route per page where the NavHost is declared, and does not
# yet write one per copy.

! sngl generate --platform gtk4 --lang go -o out state.sngl
stderr 'state.sngl:12:13: a stack''s pages are fixed when it is built, and this `for` iterates state; iterate a constant'

! sngl generate --platform gtk4 --lang go -o out cond.sngl
stderr 'cond.sngl:9:9: a stack''s pages are fixed when it is built, and this `if` reads state; decide it from constants, or write it inside a page'

! sngl generate --platform gtk4 --lang go -o out nested.sngl
stderr 'nested.sngl:11:13: pages under a `for` inside another are not supported yet: a page''s copy is one iteration'

! sngl generate --platform gtk4 --lang go -o out params.sngl
stderr 'params.sngl:14:27: page "item" is written under a `for`, one page per element, and takes no params: each copy reads its element instead'

! sngl generate --platform gtk4 --lang go -o out group.sngl
stderr 'group.sngl:16:9: extras renders pages, and a group of pages keeps no state of its own: move it into a page'

! sngl generate --platform android --lang kotlin -o out android.sngl
stderr 'android.sngl:8:9: android writes a route per page where the NavHost is declared, and a page under a `for` or an `if` is not one yet: write each page in the stack'

-- state.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var items list<string> = ["a"]

ui.window(title="State") {
    ui.vbox {
        ui.button(text="more", @click { items.push("b") })
        nav.stack #pages {
            nav.page(href="/", title="Home") {
            }
            for var it = items {
                nav.page(href="/" + it, title=it) {
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
-- cond.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var shown = true

ui.window(title="Cond") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page(href="/", title="Home") {}
        if shown {
            nav.page(href="/more", title="More") {}
        }
    }
}
-- nested.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const rows list<string> = ["a"]
const cols list<string> = ["b"]

ui.window(title="Nested") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page(href="/", title="Home") {}
        for var r = rows {
            for var c = cols {
                nav.page(href="/" + r + "/" + c, title=r + c) {}
            }
        }
    }
}
-- params.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct P {
    name string
}

const items list<string> = ["a"]

ui.window(title="Params") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page(href="/", title="Home") {}
        for var it = items {
            nav.page #item(href="/" + it, title=it, params=P{name=it}) {}
        }
    }
}
-- group.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component extras {
    var n = 0

    nav.page(href="/faq", title="FAQ") {
        ui.button(text="n {n}", @click { n += 1 })
    }
}

ui.window(title="Group") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page(href="/", title="Home") {
        }
        extras
    }
}
-- android.sngl --
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const items list<string> = ["a"]

ui.window(title="Android") {
    nav.stack #pages {
        for var it = items {
            nav.page(href="/" + it, title=it) {}
        }
    }
}
